gaps.title: Missing automatic synchronization of Moodle role hierarchy
gaps.jtbd: When roles are updated in Moodle, I want them to sync to the archive role model automatically, so that user access remains correct.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a role update in Moodle, When the synchronization process runs, Then the user's role in the archive is updated.
gaps.reason: The client brief explicitly requires 'Синхронизация и отображение иерархии ролей Moodle в ролевую модель архива'. The code implements a mapping mechanism that maps Moodle roles to internal roles when a user logs in, but there is no active 'synchronization' process or background job syncing the role hierarchy between Moodle and the system outside of individual login events.

gaps.title: Missing fully autonomous fallback for auth processing
gaps.jtbd: When the external LMS fails, I want the system to seamlessly switch to fallback mechanisms without exposing the failure to the user, so that the workflow is uninterrupted
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given LMS is down, When the system processes an auth token, Then it uses autonomous fallback gracefully without throwing 500.
gaps.reason: The client brief explicitly requires 'Устойчивость к сбоям внешней LMS (автономный fallback)'. While there are fallback structures in the code, they are not fully autonomous or graceful in all paths. For example, if SSO fails due to server error (LmsServerException) and no fallback password was provided, it returns a 500 error instead of gracefully handling the autonomous fallback via locally cached claims.

gaps.title: Missing true SSO implementation in /sso/moodle
gaps.jtbd: When I log in via SSO, I want it to securely authenticate against the external provider
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given valid SSO credentials, When I call /sso/moodle, Then my token is securely verified and logged in
gaps.reason: The brief requires 'Единая сквозная аутентификация (SSO) через Moodle (OAuth2 / OIDC / LTI)'. While LTI seems implemented, the /sso/moodle endpoint is explicitly mocked out: 'Minimal mock validation for SSO token to prevent arbitrary auth bypass. In a real implementation, this would involve verifying an OAuth2/OIDC token or SAML assertion against the Moodle identity provider's public keys'. True SSO verification logic for this flow is missing.
